headline: President Clinton signed an order changing an earlier order on how the US runs the Enterprise for the Americas Initiative.
what_it_does: This order makes more changes to Executive Order 12757, which set out how federal agencies carry out the Enterprise for the Americas Initiative. That program deals with US relations with Latin American and Caribbean countries, such as reducing debt owed to the US and supporting local environmental funds. No summary was provided, so the specific changes this order makes are not known from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run the Enterprise for the Americas Initiative
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules or assignments these agencies follow under the earlier order, though the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, December 3, 1996, though the source does not say.
